plugins.name: DeepSeek CLIProxyAPI Provider
plugins.description: DeepSeek provider for CLIProxyAPI with protocol-aligned passthrough: anthropic, chat-completions and responses requests are forwarded to the matching DeepSeek endpoint without cross-protocol translation, so reasoning history and tool calls survive untouched. Credentials live in the host, usage records are logged, keys are managed through the host Management API.
plugins.author: xspeed1989
